definitions.expectedPoints: Expected Points means ESPN weekly projected fantasy points only. No historical draft benchmark is labeled as expected points.
definitions.draftValue: Draft Value Percentile ranks a player's full-season fantasy-point outcome against other LFL picks at the same position and draft round. The player being graded is excluded from the comparison set. It is a relative draft outcome measure, not a fantasy-point projection.
definitions.projection: ESPN weekly projected points versus actual points for the same weeks where ESPN retained a projection. Historical projection coverage is available for 2018-2025.
definitions.draftTeamProduction: Actual starter points scored while the player was still on the franchise that drafted him. Bench points and starter points after leaving the drafting franchise do not count.
definitions.classGrades: Draft-class grades are percentile bands of average centered Draft Value Score (Draft Value Percentile minus 50) across all 156 historical LFL classes.

meta.qualityNote: Playoff bracket-bye rows are excluded from weekly production-quality downgrades.
